payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the model's performance against baseline methods in the context of recipe retrieval, highlighting efficiency and effectiveness in training and retrieval accuracy.

claims.text: The proposed model performs similarly to the baseline implementation of BIBREF17 in recipe retrieval tasks.
The model significantly reduces training time compared to baseline methods, achieving results in under 30 hours versus up to 6 days for others.
The model offers more flexibility for dataset alterations and can utilize a larger number of samples effectively compared to baselines.
Qualitative results indicate that the model creates more distinct class clusters than baseline methods, enhancing retrieval accuracy.
